_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Factor score sits inside Denial band in a documented coil; -2.2% day and weak ETF/fed_liquidity are unfinished impulse, not confirmed break to Panic or lift to Anxiety.
next_move.brains_agree: No clean agree — analyst explicit Denial/HOLD medium; narrative silent on phase/forward and only supplies risk-off color
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear_greed holds 24-38, 30d momentum near 50, funding neutral, price fails to reclaim ~78200 over next 12-24h
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear_greed <24 + funding negative + another >3% down day (to Panic), or BTC holds ~78200 + ETF flows up + fear >39 (to Anxiety)
